newsitem.title: USA: US corporate debt issuance tops $1.0 bln, tone firm.
newsitem.headline: US corporate debt issuance tops $1.0 bln, tone firm.

text.p: More than $1.0 billion investment grade corporate debt hit the market on Tuesday as long U.S. Treasury yields retreated to an eight-month low, pressuring spreads only in spots, dealers said.
Sectors showing signs of indigestion were banking and insurance companies, traders said. Still-scarce new industrial paper was more resilient, meanwhile.
"It's a great time to issue bonds because it's also a good time to buy," one trader said. "There has been no serious breakdown in market sentiment thanks to both govies and the stock market."
